title: A Wardrobe for the Aftermath
author: Sable Ashgrove
blurb: Emrys Reyes, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
